name: Open-drain pull-up presence
description: Design-review check: an open-collector/open-emitter net needs a pull-up to a rail. Uses schematic pin types (I2C SDA/SCL stay covered by i2c_pullup_presence as the name-based fallback).
what_it_measures: Count of open-drain nets (by pin type) with no pull-up resistor to a rail.
